authorInfo.bio: Frederic Shoberl (1775–1853), also known as Frederick Schoberl, was an English journalist, editor, translator, writer and illustrator. Shoberl edited Forget-Me-Not, the first literary annual, issued at Christmas "for 1823" and translated The Hunchback of Notre-Dame.

description: "Narrative of the Most Remarkable Events Which Occurred in and near Leipzig..." is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The book chronicles the significant military engagements surrounding Leipzig during the tumultuous period of the Napoleonic Wars, specifically from October 14th to 19th in 1813.
